## Course Roadmap

| Week | Core Topics | Key Mathematical Tools | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01 - 02** | Review of Newtonian Mechanics, Damped & Driven Oscillations | Complex numbers, ODEs, Green's functions | Available |
| **03 - 04** | Calculus of Variations & Hamilton's Principle | Functional differentiation, Euler-Lagrange, Constraints | Available |
| **05 - 06** | Central Forces, Kepler's Laws & Orbital Scattering | Effective potential, Binet equation, Rutherford cross-section | In Progress |
| **07 - 08** | Non-Inertial Reference Frames & Coriolis Effects | Rotating coordinates, Foucault pendulum, centrifugal potential | Upcoming |
| **09 - 10** | Rigid Body Dynamics & The Inertia Tensor | Principal axes, Euler angles, Euler's equations of motion | Upcoming |
| **11 - 12** | Hamiltonian Mechanics, Poisson Brackets & Chaos | Phase space volume (Liouville's theorem), Lyapunov exponents | Upcoming |
